title: kbmon --events drops a coord event's comma-separated id list, so coord.intent loses its item
goal: a coord field holding comma-separated ids (intent item, topic, touch) becomes name_n and name_1.. as a list does, each part an id that passed redact.redact

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
H=tempfile.mkdtemp();T=os.path.join(H,'c.sqlite')
E=dict(os.environ,CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA=H,CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=os.getcwd(),KB_COORD_STORE=T)
r=s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/coord.py','post','--kind','intent','--field','session=PL-LT-00123','--field','item=ST-aaaaaaaa,ST-bbbbbbbb'],capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,timeout=60)
if r.returncode: print('post failed: '+r.stderr[-200:]);sys.exit(2)
d=json.loads(s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py','--events'],capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,timeout=120).stdout)
ev=[x for x in d.get('events',[]) if x.get('name')=='coord.intent']
if not ev: print('no coord.intent event');sys.exit(1)
a=ev[-1].get('attributes',{})
if not any(k.startswith('item') for k in a): print('coord.intent lost its item: %r'%a);sys.exit(1)
print('ok: coord.intent keeps its item list')

notes: SP-qvlnptiw review (ST-jx3c5vxm g3 changed to split comma-separated id lists).
